## Problem

What's the friction or limitation today? Describe the use case from your perspective.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like MyGG to do. Be concrete — tool name, behavior, configuration knobs.

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you thought about and why they don't fit.

## Additional context

Examples, screenshots, links to similar features in other projects.
